data.name: ConnectHint
data.value: Verify the host fingerprint through a trusted channel. Profiles do not store passwords.

data.name: AuditHint
data.value: The audit only reads server state. Automatic changes require a supported OS and service combination.

data.name: EmptyAudit
data.value: Connect to a server to run the audit.

data.name: ConfigureHint
data.value: No changes are made yet. A matching private key is required to verify the new login.

data.name: ReadPublicKey
data.value: Read public key from private key

data.name: KeyHint
data.value: No keys yet? Select Ed25519 or RSA 4096, enter a passphrase of at least 12 characters, then select “Generate key…”. Choose PPK v3 or PKCS#8 PEM when saving. The private key and .pub file are saved together; only the public key is uploaded. Keep both files and the passphrase safe: a forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered.

data.name: NewExportPuttyHint
data.value: For an existing key, select its private key file above, enter its current passphrase, then select “Export for RDM / PuTTY…”. The new .ppk file contains the same key and fingerprint. You do not need to apply the server settings again.

data.name: PuttyKeyExported
data.value: Key exported as PPK v3. Select this .ppk file in your client; it uses the same passphrase.

data.name: NoPasswordSudo
data.value: NOPASSWD: sudo without a password (full server control)

data.name: DisablePassword
data.value: Disable SSH password login after key verification

data.name: CloseOldPort
data.value: Remove the old listening port after verification

data.name: DisableForwarding
data.value: Disable tunnels, agent forwarding and X11

data.name: MaxRetry
data.value: Failed logins before an IP ban

data.name: Fail2BanHint
data.value: The SSH limit applies to one connection. Fail2ban counts failures from one IP within the chosen period, across connections. Defaults: 3 failures in 10 minutes and a 1-hour ban. The administrator IP seen by the server is whitelisted. On Debian/Ubuntu, Fail2ban is installed from the configured OS repositories if needed; on RPM systems, it must already be installed.

data.name: SafetyHint
data.value: Both ports remain available during verification. The app verifies the key and required privileges again after the final changes.

data.name: PreviewHint
data.value: Review every step. Prepare cloud firewalls and external network rules separately.

data.name: EmptyPlan
data.value: Run an audit and build a plan first.

data.name: LogHint
data.value: The log records steps and results. Secret data is excluded.

data.name: BansHint
data.value: Uses the sshhardener-sshd jail. Enter an exact IP address to unban.

data.name: ConfirmHost
data.value: Verify the host fingerprint through an independent trusted channel. Trust this key?

data.name: ConfirmApply
data.value: Server settings will change. Is the new port allowed in the cloud firewall, has the plan been reviewed, and is provider console recovery available?

data.name: ConfirmRisk
data.value: An indefinite ban or NOPASSWD sudo is selected. Do you understand the impact and have you verified the administrator whitelist?

data.name: ConfirmRollback
data.value: Restore settings from the last transaction? The current connection may close.

data.name: KeyGenerated
data.value: Key pair created. Keep both files and the passphrase in a secure location.

data.name: OperationCancelled
data.value: Operation cancelled. Check the server rollback result.

data.name: KeyExists
data.value: The file already exists. Choose a new filename.

data.name: PortInvalid
data.value: Port must be an integer from 1 to 65535.

data.name: NoAudit
data.value: A server audit is required for a report.

data.name: CloseBusy
data.value: Changes are still running. Cancel and wait for rollback before closing.

data.name: ValidationNote
data.value: Module support is checked when building the plan. Unsupported scenarios are blocked.

data.name: PlanBusy
data.value: Wait for the current operation to finish.

data.name: PlanConnectRequired
data.value: Connect to the server and run an audit.

data.name: PlanReconnectRequired
data.value: Connection settings have changed. Reconnect and run the audit again.

data.name: PlanAuditRequired
data.value: Run a server audit before building the plan.

data.name: PlanAdminRequired
data.value: Root/sudo access has not been verified for this connection. On the Connect tab, use an account with sudo privileges and enter its sudo password if required, then reconnect. “Grant administrator access with sudo” applies to the new user.

data.name: AuditReadOnly
data.value: The audit is read-only: root/sudo access has not been verified. You cannot build or apply a plan.

data.name: EmptyProfiles
data.value: Save the connection settings to reconnect to this server quickly next time. Profiles do not store passwords.

data.name: EmptyBans
data.value: Connect to a server and select “Refresh bans” to read the sshhardener-sshd jail ban list.

data.name: OperationHistoryHint
data.value: Select an operation, connect to its server, and check its state. Passwords must be entered again.

data.name: HistoryEmpty
data.value: No operations yet. Applying changes will create a recovery record here.

data.name: HistoryNotChecked
data.value: The server state has not been checked. Connect and select “Check state”.

data.name: HistoryLastConfirmed
data.value: Last confirmed: {0}, {1}. Check the server again.

data.name: HistoryDifferentServer
data.value: This connection does not match the selected operation. Use its original or new connection settings.

data.name: HistoryLoadFailed
data.value: Could not read the operation history. New changes are blocked until history can be saved.

data.name: HistorySaveFailed
data.value: Could not update the local history. This does not change the operation’s result on the server.

data.name: HistorySaved
data.value: Operation details saved without passwords or key passphrases.

data.name: HistoryCredentialsRequired
data.value: Connection settings filled in. Enter the password or key passphrase, then connect.

data.name: HistoryCheckFailed
data.value: The operation’s server state could not be verified. Check the connection and try again.

data.name: HistoryRollbackUnavailable
data.value: Rollback is unavailable for the current state, or a newer operation has been applied.

data.name: HistoryHostChanged
data.value: The server key does not match the saved operation. Connection stopped.

data.name: HistoryRollbackConfirm
EmptyLog
data.value: Execution steps and verification results will appear here. No changes have been applied yet.

data.name: RollbackComplete
data.value: The server confirmed manual rollback of the changes.

data.name: BulkReady
data.value: Import hosts, audit them, and review each individual plan.

data.name: BulkIndependentTransactions
data.value: Each host has its own transaction and recovery. There is no atomic rollback of the entire batch. Stopping prevents new hosts from starting; active hosts finish verification or recovery.

data.name: BulkPolicySummary
data.value: Settings come from the main form. Target user, port, access and sudo:

data.name: BulkSharedKey
data.value: The same explicitly selected target key will be installed on selected hosts:

data.name: BulkInvalidKey
data.value: Check the target private/public key pair in the main form.

data.name: BulkCsvHint
data.value: CSV: host is required; port, username, privateKeyPath, id and displayName are optional. Passwords and MFA secrets are forbidden. Each host may occur only once, even with different ports.

data.name: BulkStopOnFailure
data.value: Stop starting hosts after a failure

data.name: BulkReviewHost
data.value: Review this host's audit and plan below.

data.name: BulkReviewAll
data.value: Review each host's plan. Apply asks for credentials again, separately for each server.

data.name: BulkPreviewFailed
data.value: Some plans are not ready. Check credentials and host requirements, then repeat the audit.

data.name: BulkSelectHost
data.value: Select a host to inspect its audit and plan.

data.name: BulkCancelling
data.value: Stopping new hosts. Waiting for active transactions to finish verification or recovery…

data.name: BulkCancelled
data.value: Cancelled. Check each individual host's outcome.

data.name: BulkInputFailed
data.value: Could not import hosts. Check CSV syntax, endpoints, host uniqueness and the 256-host limit.

data.name: BulkOperationFailed
data.value: The operation could not finish. Each host's outcome and recovery history are independent.

data.name: BulkCredentialsHint
data.value: Enter credentials only for this host. They remain in memory for the connection and are not saved to profiles or CSV.

data.name: BulkSourceKey
data.value: Source key passphrase (empty for an unencrypted key):

data.name: BulkSourceSudo
data.value: Original user's sudo password (empty for root / NOPASSWD):

data.name: BulkCredentialRequired
data.value: Enter the SSH password or import a profile / CSV containing a source key path.

data.name: BulkTargetPasswordHint
data.value: Enter the target account password. A new user's password needs at least 12 characters.

data.name: BulkTrustHint
data.value: Compare the fingerprint through an independent channel. Trust this host?

data.name: BulkApplyConfirmation
data.value: Apply the reviewed individual plans to the selected servers? Host count:

data.name: MfaCodeHint
data.value: Enter a current six-digit authenticator code or an eight-digit recovery code. The code is not saved.

data.name: MfaInvalidCode
data.value: The code does not match. Check the authenticator account and device clocks.

data.name: MfaEnrollmentHint
data.value: Add a separate account in Google Authenticator or a compatible app: TOTP, SHA-1, six digits, 30 seconds. The secret and recovery codes are shown only in this dialog; save them securely.

data.name: MfaUriLabel
data.value: otpauth URI for a compatible authenticator:

data.name: MfaRecoverySaved
data.value: I saved the recovery codes securely

data.name: MfaConfirmCode
data.value: Confirm the current code from the newly added account:

data.name: MfaSaveRecoveryFirst
data.value: Save the recovery codes and check the confirmation first.

data.name: BulkTargetVerificationPassword
data.value: Existing target account password for sudo verification (empty for NOPASSWD):

data.name: SftpHint
data.value: Connect with the selected user's permissions. Passwords are not saved. Only empty folders can be deleted.

data.name: SftpDisconnected
data.value: Enter connection details to browse the server.

data.name: SftpDenied
data.value: The server denied this operation. Check the selected user's permissions.

data.name: SftpHostChanged
data.value: The server host key changed. Verify it using a trusted console.

data.name: SftpFailed
data.value: The operation did not finish. Check the connection, path and permissions; reconnect if needed.

data.name: SftpOverwrite
data.value: The file already exists. Replace it?

data.name: SftpDeleteConfirm
data.value: Delete the selected item? Folders must be empty. This action cannot be undone.

data.name: SftpEnterName
data.value: Enter a single name without a path:

data.name: KeyAlgorithmHint
data.value: Ed25519 is a modern compact key; RSA 4096 supports systems requiring RSA. Choose the encrypted file format when saving.

data.name: AccessRoleHint
data.value: Choose access for the specified account. Explicitly select a sudo policy for a new account.

data.name: AccessTargetPasswordHint
data.value: A new password-sudo account needs at least 12 characters. For an existing account enter its current password; leave empty for NOPASSWD with existing permissions. The password is not saved.

data.name: AccessRestrictedServices
data.value: Exact systemd service names, one per line (for example nginx.service)

data.name: AccessRestrictedHint
data.value: Selected services permit status checks. A restart runs as root: the account must not be able to modify a service's executables or configuration. Arbitrary commands and wildcards are not accepted.

data.name: AccessSftpHint
data.value: The SFTP account is restricted to its own /uploads chroot directory, without shell, terminal or forwarding. It receives no sudo privileges.

data.name: AccessSourceAdministratorHint
data.value: For an SFTP or restricted account, connect with a separate administrator using a private key. A fresh administrator login and root access on the final port are checked before commit.

data.name: AccessEnableTotp
data.value: Require a key plus a TOTP code

data.name: AccessMfaHint
data.value: MFA applies to the selected account. Add a separate authenticator account and confirm a code. The secret and recovery codes appear only in the setup dialog; save recovery codes before closing it. Bulk setup uses a different secret for each host. Clearing the checkbox preserves existing 2FA; disabling it or rotating its secret is not supported here.

data.name: AccessMfaNotEnrolled
data.value: The authenticator has not been confirmed.

data.name: AccessMfaEnrolled
data.value: Authenticator confirmed. Secrets are excluded from plans, reports and profiles.

data.name: AccessGlobalPasswordHint
data.value: Disabling password login is a server-wide SSH policy and can affect other users. TOTP is added only to the selected account.
